newsitem.title: LATVIA: SHARE TURNOVER DOWN, INDICES UP SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: SHARE TURNOVER DOWN, INDICES UP SLIGHTLY.

text.p: * Turnover fell to 67,000 lats from 104,000 lats.
* Bourse index edges up 1.18 points to 385.43, Rietumu up
* Unibanka most traded at 24,500 lats, adds two
santimes to 3.33 lats.
* Staburadze at highest trade for some time, turns
over 16,200 lats, loses one santime to 2.71 lats.
Latvian shares saw a sharp fall in
turnover on Monday although a slight gain in leading stock
Unibanka helped bourse indices to gain, dealers said.
Turnover fell to 67,000 lats from 104,000 lats and the
bourse index edged up 1.18 points to 385.43. The Rietumu Bank
index added 0.07 to 150.31.
Unibanka was the most traded at 24,500 lats,
adding two santimes to 3.33 lats.
Confectionary maker Staburadze saw a leap in trade
from recent quiet levels, turning over 16,200 lats to lose one
santime to 2.71 lats.
Dealers said that despite quiet trade of the moment, there
may be room for gains as shares were good value.
"Price levels are still quite low," said one trader. But he
did think that a rally would take place in the near future.
Apart from Staburadze and Unibanka, there were few very
active shares.
Riga Shipyard saw reasonable trade of 8,100 lats
and was unchanged at 1.31 lats while Kaija lost two
santimes to 2.10 lats on turnover of 5,400 lats.
-- Patrick Lannin, Riga newsroom, +371 721 5240
